event.label: Walcha councillor by-election following Adam Iuston resignation
event.status: NSWEC publishes a by-election date of Saturday 16 January 2027; detailed timetable awaited
event.dateBasis: Adam Iuston resigned effective 23 October 2026. Walcha Council’s 28 October draft minutes endorsed the NSW Electoral Commission’s preferred date of 16 January 2027. The NSWEC expenditure-cap schedule, updated 19 November 2026, now lists Walcha’s by-election date as 16 January 2027. The date-only clock marks the start of that date in Sydney. Nomination deadlines and polling hours await a detailed timetable.

stateResearchStatus: 28 November scoped Kempsey timetable check: NSWEC now publishes the detailed 16 January 2027 by-election timetable. Nominations run 7-16 December, closing at noon; residential rolls close 7 December at 6 pm. The complete printed deadlines are recorded with null timezone and the existing date-only clock is unchanged. Earlier resignation, roster and other source checks retain their dates. 13 November Hunter’s Hill Council South Ward by-election check: Nominations closed at noon AEDT on 11 November. NSWEC published 4 candidates in the 12 November ballot draw order. 13 November City of Coffs Harbour Council by-election check: Nominations closed at noon AEDT on 11 November. NSWEC published 5 candidates in the 12 November ballot draw order. 13 November Kempsey check: Noel Selby resigned effective 4 November. Council confirms a 16 January 2027 by-election and lists Arthur Bain as Deputy Mayor. Scoped 22 November Kempsey deadline check: Council gives a non-residential-roll application deadline of 6 pm on Monday 7 December 2026. This applies only to the two non-residential rolls, not the general electoral roll or candidate nominations. The source does not print a timezone for this deadline. 20 November scoped Walcha date check: NSWEC now publishes 16 January 2027 as the by-election date following Adam Iuston’s 23 October resignation. Nomination deadlines and polling hours remain unverified. Coffs Harbour nomination lodgement opened 2 November at 9 am AEDT, verified 3 November. Hunters Hill retains its published 2 November opening date without an independently verified opening hour. Both closed 11 November at noon AEDT. 20 November scoped Tenterfield A Ward date check: NSWEC now publishes a one-councillor by-election on 16 January 2027 following Gregory Purcell’s resignation effective 31 October. Nomination deadlines and polling hours remain unverified. Election review 1 November: Council's 20 October election notice dates Marc Lane's resignation to 14 October; 15 October is the earlier notice publication date, not the resignation date. Hunters Hill's confirmed 12 December by-election timetable is unchanged. The 31 October review of David Harris remains: he will not recontest Wyong at the 13 March 2027 state election, but remains MP and continues ministerial duties until then; no current vacancy. Cobar and Coffs Harbour retain their 30 October election review; Parliament composition retains its 23 October review and no full federal roster audit is claimed.

stateResearchReview.scope: Scoped Walcha council date-endorsement evidence. Other NSW and federal observations retain their prior dates.
